# example.com/weather

<!-- Generated by crucible. Change the model or the SDK configuration and regenerate. -->

The Go client for the Weather API (`example.weather#Weather`, API version `2026-10-01`, sent as `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request), generated by [Crucible](https://github.com/Operation-Leyline/crucible) from the service's model.

## Install

```sh
go get example.com/weather
```

The package is `example.com/weather`; code refers to it as `weather`.

## Create a client

```go
import weather "example.com/weather"

client, err := weather.NewWeatherClient(weather.Config{
	Token: func(context.Context) (string, error) { return os.Getenv("WEATHER_TOKEN"), nil },
})
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
```

`Config.Token` returns the bearer token; it is called for every attempt with the call's context, so a refreshed token is used. The client sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request.

## Call an operation

`GetCity` calls `GetCity`. Every operation has a method like it.

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
	"time"

	"example.com/weather"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	// The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request.
	client, err := weather.NewWeatherClient(weather.Config{
		Token: func(context.Context) (string, error) { return os.Getenv("WEATHER_TOKEN"), nil },
	})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}

	// Values from the model's example "Read a city".
	input := &weather.GetCityInput{
		CityId: "c-0a1b2c3d",
		At:     weather.Some(time.Date(2026, time.January, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0, time.UTC)),
	}

	output, err := client.GetCity(ctx, input)
	var notFoundError *weather.NotFoundError
	if errors.As(err, &notFoundError) {
		fmt.Printf("NotFoundError (HTTP %d): %v\n", notFoundError.Metadata.Metadata.Status, notFoundError.Message)
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(output.City)
	fmt.Println(output.GetForecast())
	fmt.Println(output.GetRequestId())
}
```

## Pagination

A paginated operation also has a `<Operation>Pages` method (`client.ListCitiesPages(input)`) returning a paginator: call `NextPage(ctx)` while `HasMorePages()` is true. Each page is one response; a repeated token stops it with an error. A paginator is for one goroutine at a time. Every method takes a `context.Context` first; an operation without input takes `weather.Unit{}`.

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"

	"example.com/weather"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	// The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request.
	client, err := weather.NewWeatherClient(weather.Config{
		Token: func(context.Context) (string, error) { return os.Getenv("WEATHER_TOKEN"), nil },
	})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}

	// Values from the model's example "List the first page".
	input := &weather.ListCitiesInput{
		MaxResults: weather.Some(int32(2)),
		Tags:       weather.Some(weather.Tags{"coastal", "capital"}),
	}

	// Each page is one response; the paginator sends `nextToken` for the next.
	pages, err := client.ListCitiesPages(input)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	for pages.HasMorePages() {
		page, err := pages.NextPage(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		fmt.Println(page.Cities)
	}
}
```

## Errors

Each modelled error is a struct such as `*weather.NotFoundError`, matched with `errors.As(err, &target)`; its `Metadata` (`*weather.ServiceError`) carries the HTTP status, request ID and headers. Every service error satisfies `weather.WeatherException`; an unmodelled one is a `*weather.ServiceError`, a transport failure a `*weather.NetworkError`, and cancellation and deadlines keep their context errors.

## Retries and idempotency

Calls are retried with backoff when a retry is safe: a modelled throttling error is retried for any operation; transport failures, HTTP 500, 502, 503 and 504 and other retryable modelled errors only for operations that are read-only, idempotent or carry an idempotency token. For operations that declare an idempotency token, an unset token is generated once per call and reused on every attempt; set it yourself to replay one logical request across calls. These operations fill a token: `CreateCity` (`ClientToken`). Set `Config.MaxAttempts` to change the attempt limit (3, the first included; 1 turns retries off) and `Config.RetryMode` to `weather.RetryModeStandard` or `weather.RetryModeAdaptive` for a shared retry quota or client-side rate limiting.
